appraise.name: Appraise
appraise.synergyNotes: Appraise common items (DC 12) or rare/exotic items (DC 15-20) to determine monetary value.

actions.name: Appraise Common Item
actions.description: Examine a common item to ascertain its approximate market value.

actions.name: Appraise Rare or Exotic Item
actions.description: Examine a rare, exotic, or antique item to determine its exact market value or authenticity.
